AI Overview
The term Bullseye game most commonly refers to the cooperative party word game by 25th Century Games, though it can also mean several other classic or active games. 
Amazon.com
 +4
25th Century Games: Bullseye (Word Party Game)
Players: 3 to 8 players 
25th Century Games
Play Time: About 25 minutes 
What's Eric Playing?
Ages: 10 and up 
25th Century Games
How It Works: One player acts as the "archer" (guesser) who needs to figure out a secret word or phrase based on a category card. The other players write down a single-letter clue on their dry-erase arrow boards. 
25th Century Games
 +1
The Twist: Before adding another letter, everyone passes their clue board clockwise. You have to continue writing a letter on someone else's half-finished clue, trying to guess what word they started. The fewer letters and turns it takes for the archer to guess correctly, the more points the team scores. 
YouTube
·How I Roll

Alternative "Bullseye" Games
If you were thinking of a different version, it might be:
Hasbro Bulls-Eye Ball: An active, electronic bouncing-target game similar to Skee-Ball.
Bullseye (Classic TV Show Board Game): A trivia and darts board game based on the retro British game show.
H2OGO! Backyard Bullseye: An inflatable 2-in-1 outdoor axe-throwing and soccer dart game.
Bullseye for Nintendo Switch: A digital adaptation of the darts and trivia game show.
